changelog: **Self-serve tenant signup API (#1749):** `POST /api/public/signup/org` creates an INTERNSHIP organization on the Community plan (`FREE`), its first ADMIN, that admin's privacy consent and the org's `Subscription` in ONE transaction, through `provisionOrganization()` (new `firstAdminAccount` step, so the account rolls back with the org; starter pack included). Off unless `SELF_SERVE_SIGNUP=true` (503 `not_enabled`, checked in the handler) — it stays off in production until tenant isolation is enforced. 5 attempts per IP per hour; never a session or an id in the response; the admin is created inactive and unverified and admits itself through the ordinary verification link; an address already in the product answers a generic 409 `signup_unavailable`; a taken slug gets a random suffix; a MARKETING host is refused (invitation-only); the operator address (`ALERT_EMAIL_TO`) gets one line per new org. `getOrCreateSubscription()` accepts a transaction client.
